Solution written to `~/TRBL-075-solution.md`.

## Summary

I cloned `github.com/trouble-agent/trouble` and verified the defect and fix end-to-end against the real commit `8edf0fe`.

**Root cause:** The sample-fold machinery (SPEC-03 §3.8a) was correct; the bug was the foldability gate. `foldableObservation` returned `Detail["sample_backed"]`, which only the PSI sampler sets. Every D-Bus merge-tracker arrival was therefore non-foldable, including counted-only repeats of an unchanged signature on an already-open incident (`res.Counted && !Opened && !Attached && !Reopened`), so each wrote its own ledger record — 15 repeats → 15 records.

**Fix (commit `8edf0fe`):**
- `internal/sensors/fold.go` — `foldableObservation` now accepts `sample_backed` **or** `foldable_repeat`; wake/fire guards unchanged.
- `internal/sensors/dbus.go` — both `emitDBusOutcome` and `dbusOutcomeDraft` set `detail["foldable_repeat"]=true` for counted-only outcomes.
- `internal/sensors/fold_dbus_test.go` — regression tests.

**Verification:**
- On parent `b7e2bb9` with the new test: `counted-only dbus repeats wrote 15 records inside the window, want 0` — FAIL (matches the reported amplification).
- On fixed tree: `TestFoldAbsorbsCountedOnlyDBusRepeats` plus all 14 fold tests PASS (`ok ... 0.432s`), with one record carrying `count>=2`, `first_ts`/`last_ts`, `fold:true`.
- The only other `internal/sensors` failure, `TestUnwatchedManagerIsNamed`, is a pre-existing host artifact (no `/run/dbus/system_bus_socket`); it fails identically on the parent and is unrelated.

The markdown contains the exact diffs, reproduction commands, real captured output, and the general guidance for future sensors to mark foldability.

# Evidence
- Problem class: dbus-sensor-sig-repeat-within-merge-window

signatures.description: Trouble sensor idle amplification: one D-Bus sig repeated 15x in 2 minutes on an idle host despite sensors.merge_window=5s (~54 ledger records/2min, ~10MB/day). Root cause: the count-preserving sample fold (eventFold, SPEC-03 section 3.8a) only absorbed observations whose Detail carried sample_backed=true, and only the PSI sampler (psi.go) sets that flag. D-Bus merge-tracker outcomes therefore never folded: every counted-only arrival (repeat of an unchanged signature counted into an already-open incident) wrote its own ledger record. Fix: counted-only D-Bus outcomes (res.Counted && !res.Opened && !res.Attached && !res.Reopened) set Detail[foldable_repeat]=true in both emitDBusOutcome and the batch-path dbusOutcomeDraft; foldableObservation accepts sample_backed OR foldable_repeat (fire/wake guards untouched, so firing and incident-state-change events still write immediately). The fold machinery itself was already correct - the bug was purely the foldability gate. General lesson for this codebase: any new sensor that emits repeated identical observations must mark its Detail so foldableObservation can absorb it, or it reintroduces the TRBL-009 amplifier class one sensor at a time.
